RECOMMENDATION: IT DEPENDS
LIKELIHOOD: 40

An all-male panel is a recognized risk factor for implicit bias and frequently violates modern civil service diversity guidelines. However, on its own, it does not prove unlawful discrimination, especially as the appointed candidate presented relevant qualifications and international leadership experience.

First, follow up professionally on your request for written feedback and request the anonymized scoring rubrics. Check your ministry’s recruitment code to see if single-sex panels breach internal hiring policy. If procedural rules were violated, or if the subsequent feedback relies on subjective, non-job-related criteria, you have credible grounds to challenge the process. Raising bias claims prematurely without documentation risks harming your reputation without altering the outcome.
